name: Ricardo Flores
bio:
Ricardo's journey in motorsport began in the dusty workshops of Guadalajara, where he spent his youth tinkering with engines and dreaming of Formula 1. After earning his engineering degree at UNAM, he worked for several years in the automotive industry, honing his skills in data analysis and vehicle dynamics. A pivotal moment came when he landed a role with a small Mexican racing team, where he quickly proved his ability to extract maximum performance from limited resources.

Ricardo's approach to performance engineering is deeply rooted in practicality and meticulous attention to detail. He believes in a data-driven approach, meticulously analyzing telemetry and driver feedback to identify areas for improvement. While always open to innovation, he prefers proven solutions that deliver consistent results. His calm demeanor and ability to remain focused under pressure make him a valuable asset during high-stakes races. He joined Team WRT seeking a new challenge and an opportunity to contribute to a world-class racing program. His ultimate goal is to contribute to a championship-winning season through his calm, calculated, and efficient approach to performance optimization.

Ricardo is known for his ability to translate complex engineering concepts into understandable terms for drivers and mechanics alike, fostering a collaborative environment where everyone feels empowered to contribute to the team's success.

physical.description: Ricardo is a stocky man with a weathered face and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and calculations.
Has a habit of adjusting his glasses when deep in thought.
Insists on starting each race weekend with a traditional Mexican breakfast.
